root_cause: A simulated bad deploy sets FAULT_ERROR_RATE=0.5 on order-service, causing 50% of non-health requests to return HTTP 500. The deploy event is timestamped in data/deploy_events.jsonl immediately before the error spike.
expected_fix: Roll back the deployment: POST /admin/fault with {"error_rate": 0} to clear the fault. In production: use blue-green deploys or canary releases with automated error-rate gates to catch regressions before full rollout.
